name: STON.fi
description: Decentralized automated market maker (AMM) built on the TON blockchain

methodology.UserFees: User pays fee on each swap. Fees go to the protocol, LPs and optinally to the referral address.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol receives 1/3 of fees paid by users (not including referral fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 2/3 of user fees are distributed among LPs (not including referral fees).
